notes.title: Difficulty balancing UPDATE!!
notes.content:

Hope you enjoy it,

notes.title: Feedback update Sept 7th
notes.content:
Just published a new update, v1.1.8, based on the most common feedback I've received. Hope everyone likes the changes!

-Added custom control bindings
-Able to cancel slide ability
-Bug fixes

notes.title: Development Update #1
notes.content:
Hey Everyone!

Just wanted to give a quick update on development! I mostly finished all the levels and I started working on the final level for the game. I also recently added the ability to aim down the sights. Also, you can select a reticle style for the end of your weapon from the options menu. Hopefully there will be enough options that everyone can find one that they like!

[img width="300"]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39114835/00bab82985b4cfdb5ba70d721e688245800598e4.png[/img]

I'm going to start implementing platform specific things this month and I think I should be on track to being "done" by the end of the month!! So hopefully sometime in May I can solidify a release date. I'm trying my best to make the game as fun as I can, and still get it released in a reasonable timeframe!

I'll keep everyone updated as soon I get closer to a release date!!

Follow progress here:
[url=https://www.tiktok.com/@colbygamedev]TikTok[/url]
[url=https://discord.gg/36zVKyZjTh]Discord[/url]
[url=https://twitter.com/snowdaysoftware]Twitter[/url]

-Colby
